newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via 7-day system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via 7-day system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was expected to add reserves to the banking system via a round of seven day system repurchase agreements (RPs) on Monday.
Analysts forecast a $5.0 billion to $6.0 billion add need in the first half of the reserve maintenance period, which began on Thursday.

Some said that with the Fed's execution of $2.1 billion in weekend system RPs on Friday and $7.1 billion of overnight system and seven-day system RPs on Thursday, the Fed may have gotten ahead of its add need and could opt to sit on the sidelines the next couple sessions.
Federal funds were trading at the 5-1/2 percent target rate.
